r34l1sm, SCENE 1 — QUESTION 1 (THE RED PLANET)


Authentic modern VLOG-style video featuring the male character from <Picture 1> as the trivia host. Use <Picture 1> as the exact visual reference for the host's face, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and overall identity throughout the video.

Natural handheld smartphone-camera energy, realistic lighting, casual creator-style framing, expressive reactions, quick dynamic camera movements, and energetic social-media trivia pacing.

IMPORTANT VIEWER INTERACTION RULE:
The male character from <Picture 1> speaks DIRECTLY TO THE VIEWER with a natural MALE FILIPINO-ACCENTED ENGLISH VOICE. The accent should sound authentic and conversational, not exaggerated or comedic. The camera represents the viewer. The host maintains direct eye contact with the camera whenever speaking.

[Shot 1 — 0:00–0:05]

Start outside at a scenic rocky lookout during golden hour.

Handheld selfie-style medium shot.

The host walks slowly toward the camera while holding it at arm's length. Warm sunlight hits one side of his face. He suddenly stops, raises one eyebrow, and points directly toward the lens.

The camera makes a quick energetic digital punch-in as he asks the question.

HOST:
<d>[English, Male Filipino Accent] Okay, let's see how good your random trivia really is. Which planet is known as the Red Planet?</d>

The host immediately stops speaking and waits.

[Shot 2 — 0:05–0:10]

No dialogue. Five-second viewer countdown.

The camera switches from selfie framing to a stable medium shot.

Place the host slightly LEFT-OF-CENTER.

Reserve completely clean negative space in the UPPER-RIGHT portion of the frame.

MINIMAX H3 OPTIMIZED TIMER:
Display exactly ONE enormous bold WHITE number in the upper-right negative space.

NO timer box.
NO circle.
NO progress ring.
NO progress bar.
NO clock icon.
NO extra text.
NO duplicated numbers.
NO decorative UI.

Only ONE bare number is visible at any moment.

The number must be pure bright white #FFFFFF.

Use a very thick, heavy, geometric sans-serif font with clean straight edges.

The number occupies approximately 20% of the total frame height.

The number is perfectly centered within the upper-right empty area.

The number changes instantly with a HARD VISUAL CUT every exactly one second:

5
then 4
then 3
then 2
then 1

Never display two numbers simultaneously.

AUDIO SYNCHRONIZATION RULE:
Exactly ONE short, dry mechanical "CLICK" sound occurs at the exact instant each new number appears.

No echo.
No reverb.
No spoken countdown.
No background music during the countdown.

TIMELINE:

At 5:
[AUDIO: One sharp CLICK]
A giant WHITE "5" appears.
Host crosses his arms and confidently stares into the camera.

At 4:
[AUDIO: One sharp CLICK]
The "5" disappears completely and is instantly replaced by a giant WHITE "4".
Host tilts his head and raises one eyebrow.

At 3:
[AUDIO: One sharp CLICK]
The "4" disappears completely and is instantly replaced by a giant WHITE "3".
Host taps his temple twice with his index finger.

At 2:
[AUDIO: One sharp CLICK]
The "3" disappears completely and is instantly replaced by a giant WHITE "2".
Host leans toward the camera with an exaggerated suspicious expression.

At 1:
[AUDIO: One sharp CLICK]
The "2" disappears completely and is instantly replaced by a giant WHITE "1".
Host suddenly grins as if he knows the viewer has locked in an answer.

NO SPOKEN COUNTDOWN.

[Shot 3 — 0:10–0:13]

The number "1" disappears completely.

SMASH CUT.

The host is now standing in a dramatic red rocky desert environment resembling the surface of Mars.

Strong wind lightly blows his shirt and hair.

A huge dark charcoal rectangular answer card snaps into the empty space beside him.

The card contains exactly ONE line of enormous bold WHITE uppercase text:

MARS!

No other text appears.

The camera rapidly pushes toward the host.

HOST:
<d>[English, Male Filipino Accent] Mars! Iron minerals in the soil are what give it that famous rusty red color!</d>

[Shot 4 — 0:13–0:15]

The host smiles confidently and gives the camera a thumbs-up.

Suddenly, an enormous dusty wind gust blasts across the frame from right to left.

The host's eyes widen.

The wind violently blows him sideways out of frame.

[AUDIO: Powerful WHOOSH]

The camera shakes briefly from the impact.

Hard cut.
